provenance: WO-10 (2026-11-20): the ten owner-approved business intents move from the V34 USER chip grid into the engine. This file is the single source of truth; server matching scores against it — no intent prose lives in code.
validation_note: Every engine=objective objective_template MUST pass D03 interpret() (server/odai/objectives.mjs): measurable framing only — units+catalog/brand or % over days. tests/objectives.test.mjs enforces this on every run.
launch_policy: Autocreate is OFF by default; the client never launches an objective on its own. Auto-spawn happens only if the caller passes ?autocreate=true (owner gate WO-09). Matched intents render a single chat line: 'Ready to run: <label> — say the word in MGMT'.
